provenance.initialization: Repeated default upright observations, zero velocities and previous actions, root z=.688 m; then closed-loop HOLD warm-up.
provenance.registration: Warm-start measured sole midpoint and mean heading rigidly aligned to nominal home; relative foot shape preserved.
provenance.context: All five actuator groups use the reported constant delay in physics substeps. Friction 1.0, zero encoder and torso CoM offsets, zero sensor noise, no payload.
provenance.settling: Separately scored: maximum joint-speed RMS < 0.01 rad/s and root speed < 0.02 m/s throughout the final 25 HOLD ticks.
provenance.acceptance: Each command must be legal at issue. Each sole must be within strict tracking tolerances of its issued target at every handoff and its original nominal target at the final handoff.
provenance.tracking: issued_* errors vs frozen actual planted sole at issue; local_* errors vs opposite achieved sole at measurement.
provenance.units: sole poses [x m,y m,yaw rad], per-sole lists [left,right]
